title: Average of two classes
concept: Combined average of groups of different sizes is a weighted average: total points divided by total students.
kept: Class A: 10 students averaging 70; Class B: 30 students averaging 90
Question: the average of all 40 students
The (70+90)/2 = 80 idea, shown as the natural first guess and then tested
filled_in: Guess: multiple choice (80 / less than 80 / more than 80)
Activity: slide a balance point along the score line until the total distance of scores on each side is equal
Step-by-step reveal: total points per class, combined total, divide by 40
Explore: slider for number of students in class B plus a table of averages
Takeaway about class size deciding the average

changed.why: (70+90)/2 only works when both classes have the same number of students. The correct combined average is (10x70 + 30x90)/40 = 3400/40 = 85. The page explains that 80 would be right only with equal class sizes (shown in the explore slider at 10 students).

math_check: Balance pulls are computed from the 40 student scores: at 85, left = 10x15 = 150, right = 30x5 = 150. Totals 700 + 2700 = 3400; 3400/40 = 85. Explore table values come from MK.mean over generated student lists (e.g. B=10 gives 80, B=60 gives 87.14). Checker passed with no problems or warnings.
